content.value: Traverse a list with indices below size() or with an enhanced for loop. Use set to replace an element. Do not structurally modify a list during enhanced-for traversal. When removing by index, traverse backward or keep the same index after removal so adjacent matches are not skipped.

For [4, -2, -3, 7], the result is [4, 7]. Removing at index i shifts only entries after i, which a backward loop has already inspected. A forward loop that always increments can skip the second of adjacent negative entries.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
